subject: SOC2 Intake: Development Controls, Secrets & Change-Management Artifacts
messages:
From: Paige Lawson <paige@brightline-assess.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: audit-portal@orchidpayments.com
Date: 2028-05-25T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 intake: initial artifact request — SDLC controls

Hi Logan,

Thanks for agreeing to support Orchid Payments' SOC 2 intake. To get our assessment started, can you provide a focused bundle of artifacts showing your secure development controls? Specifically we need: 

- Code review evidence (sampling of PRs + reviewer log)
- CI/CD configuration showing gating rules and least-privileged runners
- Secrets/keys handling (KMS usage, rotation cadence, short-lived tokens)
- Change management: approvals and emergency rollback process

If you can share a small sample (redacted where necessary) and links to where the full evidence lives (Drive/S3/portal) that would be ideal. Target for our first pass: within 3 business days.

Thanks,
Paige Lawson
Senior Assessor, Brightline Assessments
paige@brightline-assess.com

[attachment: assessor-request-form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-25T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC2 intake: initial artifact request — SDLC controls

Team — forwarding assessor ask from Paige at Brightline. Orchid wants a compact evidence pack for SOC2. Needs samples for code review, CI gating, secrets handling, and change-management runbook.

Items I think we should provide in the bundle:
- 5 PR samples with reviewer trail and approvals (cross-service sampling)
- CI pipeline YAML showing gating and required checks
- KMS access logs + short-lived token policy doc (redacted keys)
- Formal change-approval runbook + one emergency rollback example

Karthik — can you prepare the pipeline snippet + KMS log sample? Marissa — can you pull the PR sample CSV and confirmation that PR approval is enforced by policy? Irene — want to review before we send externally. Please flag any things that require redaction or customer-sensitive data.

Irene/Marissa/Karthik — target internal draft in ~3 hours so I can validate and send to Paige this afternoon.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Customer Programs, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai

[attachment: triage-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-25T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC2 intake: initial artifact request — SDLC controls

Logan / team — attaching the artifacts I pulled together. Notes inline.

Attachments included: ci-pipeline-config.yml, kms-access-log-sample.json

Summary:
- CI/CD: Our primary GitHub Actions pipeline enforces required status checks (lint, unit-tests, infra-policy) and requires one approved review for service repo changes. The attached YAML shows the required checks and the job runner labels (no shared privileged runners for public repos). We also maintain separate protected branches for release.
- KMS/logs: Sample KMS access log contains redacted key IDs; shows rotation events (weekly rotation job) and principal IDs that are short-lived (assumed roles via STS). We use HSM-backed KMS in prod.

Caveats / redactions I performed: replaced real key IDs with key-REDACTED, removed customer-specific S3 ARNs. Full evidence is in the Drive folder (link below) with stricter access.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF_exEvidencePack

If assessors need console-level screenshots we can provide time-limited links via the audit portal.

Karthik
Senior DevOps Engineer
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

[attachment: ci-pipeline-config.yml (yaml)]
[attachment: kms-access-log-sample.json (json)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-25T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC2 intake: initial artifact request — SDLC controls

Thanks Karthik — good start. A couple of ask/clarifications before external delivery:

1) PR gating: The assessor will want an explicit PR gating policy doc or our internal page (policy name: "PR Enforcement 2.1"). Please attach the policy page link or a short PDF showing the rule set (required checks, merge restrictions, permitted bypass).
2) Change management: We should include the change-approval runbook and one example of an emergency rollback (time-stamped incident note). Marissa — can you attach the runbook and pick one recent rollback summary (redact customer data)?
3) Evidence continuity: For KMS logs, include a short statement (one-paragraph) describing retention and who has emergency decrypt access.

I will review the final bundle and confirm redactions. We should avoid sending raw console screenshots until we generate time-limited access links via the audit portal (audit-portal@orchidpayments.com).

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
irene.choi@redwood.ai

[attachment: compliance-checklist.md (markdown)]

HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/OrchidPayments-12345
